title: Please list the phone numbers of the schools with the top 3 SAT excellence
question:

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_058
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
WHERE sat.XCL_036 > 0

LIMIT 3;
